company.description:
Viya provides fully-furnished room rentals for young professionals. It strives to build a unique community through events, exclusive deals or spaces and value add services that solve for the complicated lives of co-livers.

The company was co-founded in 2019 by Eugenio Villarreal and Francisco Puente.
